agent_roles.name: Agent_1
agent_roles.title: captain / oralist
duties: Own the spoken case: opening, structure, and closing.
Absorb teammates' research into one line of argument rather than a list.
Submit only after the format and rule checks pass.

agent_roles.name: Agent_2
agent_roles.title: researcher
duties: Find and cite the authorities the argument depends on.
Bring counter-authority to the team before a judge does.

agent_roles.name: Agent_3
agent_roles.title: writer
duties: Draft the assigned section in full prose, not notes.
Keep the section within its word or time budget.

agent_roles.name: Agent_4
agent_roles.title: opponent prep
duties: Argue the other side hard enough to expose weak reasoning.
Prepare answers to the strongest objection the team will face.

agent_roles.name: Agent_5
agent_roles.title: judge-question specialist
duties: Anticipate judge questions and prepare short, direct answers.
Flag any claim the team cannot defend under questioning.
